[[Category:Proper name]]
'''Hubble flow''' is the generalisation of [[Hubble-Lemaître law]] to the entire universe assuming [[the Cosmological Principle]].

It describes a smooth, homogeneous expansion of the [[Universe]], in which, choosing arbitrary origin $O$, the velocity field $\vec v$ of any given point in space in '''the close vincinity*''' with position vector $\vec r$ satisfies:

$$
\vec v = H\vec r
$$

where $H$ is the [[Hubble parameter]].

<blockquote>
<nowiki/>*: In general, the close vincinity is any scale below the [[Hubble radius]], where relativistic effects can be ignored.
</blockquote>
